notes: hand-picked; every url was fetched on fetchedAt to confirm the name, offer and phone. InformAlberta entries come from its search for caregiver services in Calgary.

items.name: Family Caregiver Centre (Alberta Health Services, Calgary Zone)
items.offers: Information, education and support for family and friends who give unpaid care to someone with a health condition.
items.hours: Tuesday to Thursday, 8:00 am to 4:00 pm

items.name: Health Link 811
items.offers: A free phone line, open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, for health advice and information.

items.name: Caregivers Alberta
items.offers: Coaching, peer support groups, education and resources for unpaid family caregivers in Alberta.

items.name: 211 Alberta
items.offers: Free, confidential help finding community and social supports by phone, text or chat, any time.

items.name: Caregivers Support Group (Unison Society)
items.offers: A monthly support group where caregivers connect, talk about the ups and downs of caregiving and learn about useful topics.

items.name: Caregiver Kindness (Calgary Seniors' Resource Society)
items.offers: Weekly volunteer visits to a senior that give the caregiver 1 to 2 hours of respite.

items.name: Respite Connect (Independent Living Resource Centre of Calgary)
items.offers: Vetted respite workers for families and caregivers.

items.name: Caregiver Support Program (Jewish Family Service Calgary)
items.offers: Counselling, group sessions, education and resources for unpaid caregivers of seniors, open to all faiths and backgrounds.

items.name: Support Services for Seniors (The Way In Network)
items.offers: Information, referrals, benefit applications and caregiver support for Calgarians aged 65 and older living independently.

items.name: Distress Centre Calgary
items.offers: Free 24-hour crisis support by phone, text and chat, plus counselling.
